name: GitHub REST API
rate_limits: Unauthenticated: 60 req/hour per IP. Authenticated (PAT/OAuth): 5,000 req/hour. GitHub App: 5,000-12,500 req/hour (scales with users/repos). Secondary limits: 100 concurrent requests, 900 points/min (GET=1pt, POST=5pt). Code search: 10 req/min unauthenticated, 30 req/min authenticated.
notes: The largest code hosting platform API. Provides access to 400M+ repositories. Supports code search, repository metadata, commit history, issues/PRs, user profiles, and more. Unauthenticated access is very limited (60/hr) but sufficient for light use. Free PAT provides 5,000/hr. GraphQL API also available at api.github.com/graphql. Excellent for AI code search, dependency analysis, and open-source intelligence.
